CAREERS

Fulfill your career aspirations in an environment that brings out the best in you

Explore Infinite Opportunities with Healthium

We believe in celebrating exceptional people by providing a supportive work environment that fosters talent and encourages professional growth.

Here, you will have the chance to collaborate with innovative and forward-thinking leaders and work hand-in-hand with an accomplished team. With a focus on continuous learning, you will also have access to resources and opportunities that will propel you and your career forward.

Join us at Healthium and become part of a dynamic team that values exceptional talent and offers endless opportunities for career advancement!

#OneHealthium: The Healthium Way of Life

At Healthium, we have found strength in our diversity, imbued by our culture of mutual respect and empathy, as well as our adherence to the highest ethical standards – something we call #OneHealthium, the Healthium way of life.

Humility, integrity, passion and innovation together form the cornerstones of #OneHealthium and by extension, everything we create and value as an organisation. We take great pride in nurturing a team that exemplifies these ideologies, forming the core of our culture and steering us towards our vision.

Our consistent efforts have earned us the ‘Great Place to Work’ Certification for three years in a row.

A Multicultural, People-centric Workplace

Our people are our most valuable asset. Our diverse workforce is one of our biggest strengths and the rich experience they bring, across varied skill sets and backgrounds, is invaluable. Everyone at Healthium is bound together by our common values.

As a global player in precision medtech with a presence across 90+ countries and offices in India and the UK, Healthium offers a transparent and open office environment that celebrates the exchange of ideas and smooth workflow. That’s why we attribute our growth and success to our 3500 strong team, which has taken Healthium to greater heights every year.

What’s more, our emphasis on Diversity, Equity and Inclusion (DEI) has resulted in a fine pool of talent. Our employee-friendly policies, learning environment and respectful work ethic ensure that each individual feels valued, respected and inspired to excel. This, accompanied with a culture of rewards and recognition, ensures that a career at Healthium is immensely satisfying and truly rewarding.

Our Values

Living by our values of being Agile, Inquisitive, Collaborative and Accountable, our teams consistently strive to work towards our vision of providing ”access to precision medtech for every patient, globally.”

Inquisitive:

To nurture an eager desire to learn and seek new information and experiences that help achieve our vision

Agile:

To adapt to the rapidly changing global environment and explore opportunities that accelerate accessibility to our precision medtech solutions

Collaborative:

To work together with both internal and external stakeholders by securing their support and forming alliances that aid access to precision-based medtech solutions for our end users

Accountability:

To work together with both internal and external stakeholders by securing their support and forming alliances that aid access to precision-based medtech solutions for our end users

What’s in it for you?

  • The opportunity to work with inspirational, visionary leaders and great talent.
  • The opportunity to effect significant business impact across geographies and functions.
  • An exciting environment that empowers and enables you to perform your best.

Our Leadership

Led by a seasoned management team, Healthium has demonstrated its ability to develop and execute a focused strategy to grow our business, enabling us to strengthen our market position and deliver robust financial performance. This has been instrumental in enabling us to attract high-quality talent and work towards our long-term objective of delivering sustainable growth across our business and community.

Work With Us

We hire exceptionally talented individuals and ensure they are nurtured professionally. Our multi-dimensional work environment offers high growth trajectories through challenging roles with clear responsibilities, and the opportunity to work and learn through a variety of assignments. We provide full training, development, and career guidance programmes, and empower every member of our team to excel.

If you’re interested in exploring a rewarding career with Healthium, please send your CV to careers@healthiummedtech.com or apply for available roles below.

Manager - SCM | Stores | 14+ Years | Peenya, Bengaluru

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Accountable for managing end-to-end warehouse operations, inventory control and store efficiency
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Planning, Quality and Production to ensure seamless material flow and service levels
  • Monitor inventory accuracy, stock reconciliation and variance analysis while ensuring FIFO/FEFO compliance
  • Ensure timely issuance of raw and packaging materials to support uninterrupted production
  • Oversee storage, packing and dispatch of finished goods in line with quality and customer requirements
  • Plan and execute cycle counts and physical inventory audits, ensuring corrective and preventive actions
  • Optimize inbound and outbound logistics processes with accurate system updates and documentation
  • Drive productivity improvements through process optimization, layout enhancement and automation initiatives
  • Manage warehouse manpower, including shift planning, workload allocation and performance monitoring
  • Improve labor productivity through KPI tracking, workforce optimization and cost control
  • Implement 6S practices to enhance safety, efficiency and housekeeping standards
  • Ensure adherence to SOPs, EHS policies and compliance requirements across operations
  • Identify cost-saving opportunities in warehousing and transportation through optimization initiatives
  • Drive continuous improvement in service levels, operational efficiency and overall warehouse performance

Qualifications

  • Graduation / MBA with 14+ years of experience in warehouse management, inventory control or supply chain operations
